paras: The Bioko leaf-toed gecko (Hemidactylus biokoensis) is a species of forest geckos from Bioko Island (Equatorial Guinea). It occurs in the coastal areas of the island and it has also been found in a forest immediately adjacent to the beach.
Hemidactylus biokoensis can grow to 81 mm (3.2 in) in snout–vent length and about 167 mm (6.6 in) in total length.
